The '''Ques system''' was located on the [[Ac'fren Spur]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], just within the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]]-[[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] border. It connected [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]], [[Varl/Legends|Varl]] and the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]],<ref name="sisar" /> and was a motley [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] typically used by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] heading towards the Si'Klaata. Outlanders landing there were interrogated extensively.<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
